features.rule: same feature rule as run 20261015_autointerp_pilot, giving the same 24 features

examples.rule: as run 20261015_autointerp_pilot, but each low example is the unused low-value patient nearest to its high example in standardized log nodule volume (weight 3), 0-5 mm ring HU mean and solid fraction (weight 1 each). Equal weights left the high group 0.62 log units larger on average (selection of 2026-10-16 00:05, replaced)

render.rule: same rendering as run 20261015_autointerp_pilot; CT inputs that run already prepared are read from it

specificity.rule: same panel rule as run 20261015_autointerp_pilot, applied to this run's validation patients

prompts.layout: The image is a CT region of {window_mm} mm centred on a target lung nodule. Columns: axial, coronal and sagittal planes through the nodule centre in radiological orientation (yellow letters mark patient right R, anterior A and superior S). Row 1: lung window (level -600, width 1500 HU). Row 2: mediastinal window (level 40, width 400 HU).{overlay_row} The white bar is 10 mm.
prompts.overlay_row: Row 3: lung window with a coloured overlay showing where one image feature of a model responds; brighter yellow means a stronger response and no colour means no response.
